market.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Dutch Bros Foot Traffic (September 2026) for September 2026 is above 110, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the first value reported by Carbon Arc. Corrections or revisions made after the market has been settled will not affect the outcome. 

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Dutch Bros Foot Traffic was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more visits than year prior, 97 = 3% fewer visits than year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc mobile location data across 200M+ devices, matched to the same calendar days of the prior year and normalized for seasonality, weather, and holidays. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.
